method: Built-in image_gen edits of original raster templates
note: Original gold/navy colors retained solely for core-art review; no score-tier recoloring or production integration. 'Style reference' in prompts denotes an agent-generated comparison reference, not user approval.

images.prompt: Edit the provided original medal into a carefully reduced-detail successor, not a different icon. Preserve its exact recognizable central motif: a thick gold ascending zigzag performance arrow from lower-left to upper-right, breaking through a circular navy badge. Preserve the original gold and dark blue enamel medal identity, its substantial depth, round shape and mildly beveled gold rim. Enlarge the central ascending zigzag arrow relative to the frame. Reduce the triple ornate concentric ring to one elegant substantial gold rim with a fine inner edge; retain very modest cardinal diamond accents only if not competing with the arrow. Remove the dense checkerboard grid, tiny flying fragments, fine engraving and bloom; replace the busy background with a calm deep navy enamel field. Keep tasteful broad gold bevel highlights and subtle modeled shading, visibly a polished game achievement medal, NOT a flat pictogram or plain line icon. This is a base template, so use the original gold/navy reference palette only, no new tier color schemes. Centered square composition, badge fills about 88% of canvas, fully transparent outside the medal. No text, letters, numerals, ribbons or new symbolic objects. Faithfully retain the zigzag rising arrow shape and direction.

Do NOT copy Image 2's arrow or change the central subject. Preserve the gold/navy original reference palette as a base-template palette; no score-tier colors. Simplify peripheral concentric trim to a single elegant rim and small cardinal accents. Remove dense background grid, tiny sparkles and fine engraving; keep a calm navy field. Maintain the original subject's rich silhouette and a small number of clear modeled facets; DO NOT turn it into a flat monochrome app icon. Centered square, 88% occupancy, genuinely transparent outside. No text, numbers, letters or new symbols.
